title: Sylvara
description: Sylvara is a Vanilla+ modpack that enhances Minecraft with lush new terrain and world generation, while keeping performance smooth and optimized. It’s the perfect blend of fresh exploration and classic survival.
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc28309ccfef4aa5f8974b367d9fbdc969325d03.jpeg)

# Sylvara  

**Vanilla, reimagined.**  

Sylvara is a **Vanilla+ modpack** that transforms Minecraft into a world that feels more **alive, beautiful, and seamless** — without losing the charm of the original game.  

**Explore breathtaking terrain** with *Terralith* and *Continents*.  
**Discover lively towns and dungeons** through *Towns and Towers* and *Dungeons and Taverns*.  
**Immerse yourself in vibrant biomes** brought to life by *Geophilic*.  
**Enjoy smoother performance** with *Sodium*, *FerriteCore*, *EntityCulling*, and more.  

Every seed becomes a new adventure: vast continents to cross, handcrafted structures to uncover, and lush landscapes that feel natural and rewarding to explore.  

Sylvara is for builders, explorers, and adventurers who want Minecraft to feel **Vanilla, but better in every way that matters**.
